privacyObservation.publicObserver: source public outputs and final public LedgerState; errors only within selected scope
privacyObservation.publicEquivalence: declared public inputs in declaration order, identical public state and EvalContext
privacyObservation.privacyDomain: exact pinned functional invariant and precondition; invalid/ineligible attempts are not implied covered

openRequirements.name: source-elaboration
openRequirements.requiredEvidence: Prove elaboration preserves the selected entrypoint semantics, call arguments, state writes, and rejected cases.

openRequirements.name: native-semantics
openRequirements.requiredEvidence: Show accepted ZKIR and Impact executions preserve the checked source postcondition, state invariant, observer, and host ABI.

openRequirements.name: deployment-identity
openRequirements.requiredEvidence: Bind the checked operation bytes to authenticated keys, a deployed identity, and a finalized receipt on the selected network.

openRequirements.name: independent-review
openRequirements.requiredEvidence: Record independent approval of the pinned application policy, assumptions, and public observer.
